name: Break Their Chains
summary: Da’grosh asks you to free Rog’mar Scouts imprisoned in the Twilight’s Shroud. His warriors need to return to Rog’mar before they can fight again.

sections.title: Scouts in Captivity
sections.body: Da’grosh’s warriors were captured by the Twilight’s Hammer before their attack could begin. The cult’s champions took them to a fortress west of Da’grosh and imprisoned them. He asks you to free his Orc brothers and sisters in the Twilight’s Shroud.

sections.title: After the Rescue
sections.body: Da’grosh says his warriors are too hurt to fight and have returned to Rog’mar. He tells you that your work together continues.

faq.answer: Da’grosh asks you to free his captured warriors.
The Twilight’s Hammer captured Da’grosh’s warriors, the Rog’mar Scouts.
The Rog’mar Scouts are imprisoned in a fortress west of Da’grosh, within the Twilight’s Shroud.
The Twilight’s Hammer’s champions captured Da’grosh’s warriors.

angles.text: As an Orc, Da’grosh asks you to free his Orc brothers and sisters from captivity.
